about_short_description.short_description: Saudi Ground Services provides ground handling services for passengers and aircraft.

product.name: Passenger Services
product.description: Services provided to passengers from arrival to departure, covering check-in, boarding, and assistance.

product.name: Baggage Handling
product.description: Management of baggage including assembly, sorting, reconciliation, loading, unloading, and transportation.

product.name: Ramp Services
product.description: Ground support services on the ramp including aircraft pushback, towing, and servicing operations.

product.name: Cargo Services
product.description: Supervision, loading, unloading, transportation, and handling of general and special cargo.

product.name: Fleet Solutions
product.description: Provision and management of ground support equipment and vehicles for aircraft handling.

product.name: Traffic Control
product.description: Management and coordination of aircraft and vehicle movements on the airside to ensure safety and efficiency.
